title: Link concepts by hand: synonyms, broader, narrower, related, with a note
description: On the concept page: type a concept, choose the relationship by buttons (same as, broader, narrower, related, distinct from via `disambiguates`), optional note, Accept and Reject in the standard form. Uses existing relation types and `decideReferenceLink` semantics, extended to concept pairs. A fact starts as this: a typed link plus a note. Standalone claims with sources are out of scope until a need appears. Knowledge run neighbours already read accepted relations. Test case: confinement problem related to containment problem. Screenshot review.
